surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the alternating pulsing of Ph4Pb and Zr(thd)4 precursors with ozone, leading to the formation of PbZrO3 thin films. The growth is self-limiting, with the precursor pulses and purge cycles ensuring surface saturation and removal of excess precursors.
